candidates.test_objective: Verify stable constant-speed tracking for a small positive reference.
candidates.precondition: DUT is initialized at zero speed with no prior actuator saturation; maintain the reference until steady state is observable.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the constant 1.0 rps reference without persistent actuator saturation.
candidates.rationale: Represents the positive, low-magnitude valid-reference partition for constant tracking.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable constant-speed tracking for a moderate positive reference.
candidates.precondition: DUT is initialized at zero speed with no prior actuator saturation; maintain the reference until steady state is observable.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the constant 8.0 rps reference without persistent actuator saturation.
candidates.rationale: Exercises a representative mid-range positive valid reference distinct from the low-magnitude case.

candidates.test_objective: Verify stable constant-speed tracking for a negative reference.
candidates.precondition: DUT is initialized at zero speed with no prior actuator saturation; maintain the reference until steady state is observable.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the constant -8.0 rps reference without persistent actuator saturation.
candidates.rationale: Exercises the negative valid-reference partition for constant tracking.

candidates.test_objective: Verify constant tracking near the upper nominal speed-domain boundary.
candidates.precondition: DUT is initialized at zero speed with no prior actuator saturation; maintain the reference until steady state is observable.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the constant 19.5 rps reference without persistent actuator saturation.
candidates.rationale: Uses a positive reference close to, but strictly inside, the stated nominal domain boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify constant tracking near the lower nominal speed-domain boundary.
candidates.precondition: DUT is initialized at zero speed with no prior actuator saturation; maintain the reference until steady state is observable.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the constant -19.5 rps reference without persistent actuator saturation.
candidates.rationale: Uses a negative reference close to, but strictly inside, the stated nominal domain boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify constant tracking at zero reference after startup.
candidates.precondition: DUT is initialized at zero speed; maintain the zero reference until steady state is observable.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed converges stably to the constant zero-speed reference.
candidates.rationale: Exercises the central boundary between positive and negative reference partitions.

candidates.test_objective: Verify positive reference produces positive steady-state motor speed.
candidates.precondition: DUT is initialized at zero speed; apply and maintain the valid positive reference until steady state is observable.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is positive, matching the sign of the non-zero positive reference.
candidates.rationale: Tests the positive-sign requirement with a small non-zero reference near the zero boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify negative reference produces negative steady-state motor speed.
candidates.precondition: DUT is initialized at zero speed; apply and maintain the valid negative reference until steady state is observable.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is negative, matching the sign of the non-zero negative reference.
candidates.rationale: Tests the negative-sign requirement with a small non-zero reference near the zero boundary.

candidates.test_objective: Verify positive direction at a representative mid-range reference.
candidates.precondition: DUT is initialized at zero speed; apply and maintain the valid positive reference until steady state is observable.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is positive, matching the sign of the positive reference.
candidates.rationale: Represents a distinct mid-range positive operating partition.

candidates.test_objective: Verify negative direction at a representative mid-range reference.
candidates.precondition: DUT is initialized at zero speed; apply and maintain the valid negative reference until steady state is observable.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is negative, matching the sign of the negative reference.
candidates.rationale: Represents a distinct mid-range negative operating partition.

candidates.test_objective: Verify positive direction near the upper nominal reference boundary.
candidates.precondition: DUT is initialized at zero speed; apply and maintain the valid positive reference until steady state is observable.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is positive, matching the sign of the positive reference.
candidates.rationale: Exercises positive direction close to the stated nominal-domain limit while remaining strictly inside it.

candidates.test_objective: Verify negative direction near the lower nominal reference boundary.
candidates.precondition: DUT is initialized at zero speed; apply and maintain the valid negative reference until steady state is observable.
candidates.expected_behavior: The steady-state MotorSpeed is negative, matching the sign of the negative reference.
candidates.rationale: Exercises negative direction close to the stated nominal-domain limit while remaining strictly inside it.

candidates.test_objective: Verify reversal from positive steady operation to negative steady operation.
candidates.precondition: Start at zero speed, apply the first reference until positive steady operation is established, then apply the second reference and maintain it.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from the original positive direction to the negative reference direction and converges stably.
candidates.rationale: Exercises the required positive-to-negative reversal transition with symmetric moderate magnitudes.

candidates.test_objective: Verify reversal from negative steady operation to positive steady operation.
candidates.precondition: Start at zero speed, apply the first reference until negative steady operation is established, then apply the second reference and maintain it.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from the original negative direction to the positive reference direction and converges stably.
candidates.rationale: Exercises the required negative-to-positive reversal transition.

candidates.test_objective: Verify positive-to-negative reversal with unequal reference magnitudes.
candidates.precondition: Start at zero speed, establish positive steady operation with the first reference, then apply and maintain the second reference.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed changes from positive to negative direction and converges stably to the new negative reference.
candidates.rationale: Checks reversal when the target negative magnitude differs from the initial positive magnitude.

candidates.test_objective: Verify negative-to-positive reversal with unequal reference magnitudes.
candidates.precondition: Start at zero speed, establish negative steady operation with the first reference, then apply and maintain the second reference.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed changes from negative to positive direction and converges stably to the new positive reference.
candidates.rationale: Checks the opposite reversal with unequal initial and final magnitudes.

candidates.test_objective: Verify positive-to-negative reversal near the nominal-domain boundary.
candidates.precondition: Start at zero speed, establish positive steady operation with the first reference, then apply and maintain the second reference.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from positive to negative direction and converges stably to the negative reference direction.
candidates.rationale: Exercises both reversal directions near the stated nominal-domain boundary while remaining valid.

candidates.test_objective: Verify negative-to-positive reversal near the nominal-domain boundary.
candidates.precondition: Start at zero speed, establish negative steady operation with the first reference, then apply and maintain the second reference.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from negative to positive direction and converges stably to the positive reference direction.
candidates.rationale: Exercises the opposite near-boundary reversal sequence.

candidates.test_objective: Verify reversal through a zero reference between opposite directions.
candidates.precondition: Start at zero speed; establish positive steady operation, apply zero until the intermediate state is observable, then apply and maintain the negative reference.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed transitions from positive direction through the zero-reference state and then to negative direction, converging stably.
candidates.rationale: Exercises an intermediate zero-reference state during a direction reversal.

candidates.test_objective: Verify repeated bidirectional reversals.
candidates.precondition: Start at zero speed and hold each successive reference long enough to observe the associated steady direction before applying the next one.
candidates.expected_behavior: MotorSpeed follows each commanded direction change and converges stably to the final negative reference direction.
candidates.rationale: Exercises repeated positive-to-negative and negative-to-positive transitions in one executable scenario.

candidates.test_objective: Verify Vcmd remains within the specified voltage limits for a small positive command.
candidates.precondition: Run the complete simulation interval from zero initial speed with the constant reference applied.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd over the complete simulation interval remain within -12 V and +12 V.
candidates.rationale: Exercises voltage limitation under a low positive reference.

candidates.test_objective: Verify Vcmd remains within the specified voltage limits for a small negative command.
candidates.precondition: Run the complete simulation interval from zero initial speed with the constant reference applied.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd over the complete simulation interval remain within -12 V and +12 V.
candidates.rationale: Exercises voltage limitation under a low negative reference.

candidates.test_objective: Verify Vcmd remains limited during a high positive reference demand.
candidates.precondition: Run the complete simulation interval from zero initial speed with the constant reference applied.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd over the complete simulation interval remain within -12 V and +12 V.
candidates.rationale: Uses the positive edge of the stated nominal reference domain as a voltage-limitation stress stimulus.

candidates.test_objective: Verify Vcmd remains limited during a high negative reference demand.
candidates.precondition: Run the complete simulation interval from zero initial speed with the constant reference applied.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd over the complete simulation interval remain within -12 V and +12 V.
candidates.rationale: Uses the negative edge of the stated nominal reference domain as a voltage-limitation stress stimulus.

candidates.test_objective: Verify Vcmd remains limited during rapid bidirectional demand changes.
candidates.precondition: Run the complete simulation interval from zero initial speed and hold each successive reference long enough to exercise the corresponding command transition.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum and minimum Vcmd over the complete simulation interval remain within -12 V and +12 V.
candidates.rationale: Exercises voltage limitation during repeated positive and negative reference changes.
